protocol.order: 20 rotating blocks of five fresh processes
protocol.search: prepared molecules; first and second calls timed per case
protocol.validation: RDKit checks output parseability, atom and bond counts, and matches against inputs after timing
protocol.note: The chematic API returns a concrete molecule; RDKit and COSMolKit return SMARTS. RDKit parse includes first-use initialization. Matching counts and input matches do not prove query semantic equivalence. Invalid or differing results cannot support speed ratios.
